subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lead-in and reading for detail: preparing to study abroad
outcomes: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of studying abroad
Skim and read a text in detail about preparing to study abroad

tf.s: Studying abroad can help you improve your language skills.
tf.why: Yes, using a language every day improves it.

tf.s: Culture shock is an advantage of studying abroad.
The text says a positive attitude influences how you behave.
tf.why: Your attitude affects how you act and cope.

tf.s: Sorting out issues at home before leaving helps you focus on your new life.
tf.why: Then you have fewer worries while abroad.

tf.s: Doing your own washing and ironing before leaving can make you more confident.
tf.why: It shows you can cope on your own.

tf.s: Homesickness is one possible disadvantage of studying abroad.
tf.why: Being far from family can make you miss home.

tf.s: You should find out nothing about the university before you go.
tf.why: Finding out about the university is part of preparing.

tf.s: Skimming means reading every word slowly.
tf.why: Skimming is reading quickly for the main idea.

tf.s: A scholarship is money given to help a student pay for studies.
tf.why: Many students study abroad on a scholarship.

mcq.q: Which is a disadvantage of studying abroad?
mcq.why: Culture shock can make the first weeks hard.

mcq.q: Which of these is NOT an advantage of studying abroad?
What does the text advise students to sort out before leaving?
mcq.why: Then they can focus on their new life.

mcq.q: What does the text say about doing your own washing and ironing before leaving?
o: It helps you feel confident about coping alone
It is a waste of time
The university does it for you

mcq.q: Huda will study in the UK next year. What is the best way to prepare?
o: Find out about the university and learn to look after herself
Pack on the last day without any plan
mcq.why: Good preparation makes the change easier.

mcq.q: Majid arrives abroad and feels confused by the new customs. What is he experiencing?
mcq.why: New customs can cause culture shock.

mcq.q: Ali has one minute to find the main idea of a paragraph. What should he do?

mcq.q: Why can a positive attitude help a student abroad?
o: It influences how they behave and cope
It means they never miss home
mcq.why: A positive attitude helps you deal with problems.

mcq.q: Why is it wise to sort out issues at home before leaving?
o: You can focus more on your new life
You will never need to call home
Your family will move with you
mcq.why: Unfinished problems at home can distract you.

mcq.q: Why can homesickness be a bigger problem when you study abroad?
o: You are far from your family for a long time
mcq.why: Distance from family makes missing home stronger.
